curatedMovie.curiosityHook: As an extreme multi-day race tests every ounce of human stamina, an unexpected stray keeps pace—raising the question of what victory actually looks like.
curatedMovie.description: During a ten-day, 435-mile race, adventure racer Michael Light forms a close bond with a street dog named Arthur.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Exciting and warmly emotional; a brisk, engaged adventure that balances extreme physical drive with heartfelt loyalty.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Simon Cellan Jones pairs high-stakes wilderness racing with an emotional, grounded bond between an athlete and a resolute stray, delivering swift momentum and sincere heart.
